description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

What you burn to keep the Oath comes back as ash you can burn again.

The first Conviction you spend on a Vow in an encounter in which you have used The Answer comes back: you regain that 1 Conviction at the end of the encounter. Conviction spent on anything other than a Vow, or in an encounter with no Answer, stays spent.

cinderfall.incomplete: Conviction is Cinderfall's renamed Focus Point pool (every Vow spell carries a 'Focus 1' cost tag). No rule element anywhere in pf2e-source writes to system.resources.focus.value -- confirmed via grep -rl "resources.focus.value" pf2e-source/packs/pf2e returning zero files. Every real rule element touching that path only adjusts .max via ActiveEffectLike mode:"upgrade" (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/clarity-of-focus.json), never .value. There is no rule-element mechanism to conditionally refund a spent Focus/Conviction point keyed to an in-encounter trigger.
